title: Pair sum
prompt: Return the indices of two distinct values whose sum equals target. Return null when no pair exists.
solution: Track each value's index in a map. Before inserting a value, check whether target minus that value exists. This avoids reusing an index and takes O(n) time.

title: Balanced brackets
prompt: Check whether a string containing ()[]{} has correctly nested matching brackets. The empty string is balanced.
solution: Push opening brackets onto a stack. For each closing bracket, pop and compare its matching opener. Reject mismatches or an empty stack. At the end the stack must be empty.

title: Merge intervals
prompt: Merge overlapping inclusive intervals. Input may be unsorted. Return sorted disjoint intervals without mutating the input.
solution: Copy and sort intervals by start. Extend the most recent merged interval when its end reaches the next start; otherwise append a new interval. Time is O(n log n).
